title: Coordinate projection equation for proper normalization
statement: The fixed-coordinate image of the expanded proper component, followed by the direct and target tensor coordinate comparisons, equals the fixed direct-image right-derived lower-star projection map.

source.place: Proper-factor paragraph: coefficient normalization before the fixed-scalar counit transpose

proof.text: Apply the existing identity-open coefficient square to the explicit compact-support comparison. Naturality of the direct-image coefficient comparison gives the proper coefficient square. Combine finiteProperNormalization with naturality of the proper candidate and the inverse realization unit to identify proper support coordinates with direct-image coordinates.

The identity-open adjunction counit normalization determines its unit by the triangle identity. Combine the derived identity pullback comparison with the identity tensor coherence, derived directly on schemes from the proved pullback tensor composition theorem and the pullback right-unit law. Taking the open adjunction transpose identifies the inverse identity-open projection with tensoring its canonical identity map. The pullback left-unit law and naturality of the direct-image projection then identify projectionMapOfCompactification for ofIsProper with rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap after identityFactorFixedProper. Evaluate the direct-image projection through a private wrapper with explicit tensor endpoints before specializing the coefficient ring, so its kernel proof reuses the generic equation without unfolding the derived tensor construction.

Use the existing fixed_component_realization calculation to realize the finite component. Substitute the two proper-support coordinate identities and the fixed proper projection identity. Tensor-coordinate naturality moves the inverse proper identification to the first input; tensor functoriality and the proper isomorphism inverse law cancel it, yielding directTensorCoordinates followed by the fixed direct-image projection.

theorem properComponent_fixed_realization_coordinate_projection
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Y.obj.left) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    let pc :=
      ((partialTensor S Y).map ((S.finite.properIdentity f).inv.app K)).app L ≫
        component S f (.ofIsProper f.hom.left) K L ≫
        (S.finite.properIdentity f).hom.app
          (((partialTensor S X).obj K).obj ((torPull S f).obj L))
    (coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Y).map pc ≫
        (directCoordinates S f (((partialTensor S X).obj K).obj ((torPull S f).obj L))).hom ≫
        (fixedDirect (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) f).map (targetCoordinates S f K L).hom =
      (directTensorCoordinates S f K L).hom ≫
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n)))
          f.hom.left).app
            ((coordinates (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X).obj K)).app
              ((realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Y).inverse.obj L.obj)
